title: Price the KV cache
hints: The repeat factor is a division: query heads over KV heads. Qwen2.5-7B gives 7, V4.1-Flash gives 64.
KV bytes need the factor of 2 for keys and values, then layers, heads, width, byte width.
A full context is one multiplication away — but check the window first: gpt-oss never multiplies past 128.
